answer: New identities enter on the lowest terrace and earn upward movement only through verified contributions. Each level requires a sponsor to lock copper - real stake, not reputation points - in a violet-bonded escrow. If the newcomer proves fake, the copper is burned and the sponsor drops a terrace. An attacker wanting a thousand trusted accounts must either do a thousand terraces of genuine work or find a thousand sponsors willing to burn their own copper - the defense prices fakes out of existence.
